messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for v3.16 -> canary-eu, group=6. Change window 2026-03-23 09:00-10:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.16
lucas: Quick ask — where's the backout doc and who's rollback owner? Also, any recommended hotpin thresholds?
priya: Backout doc: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.16. I'm volunteering as rollback owner. Hotpin guidance: only if p95 >210ms for 3m and sustained 5xx >0.5% 
emily: Metric watches created: p95 alert @210ms, 5xx alert @0.5%. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/alerts/5678
sven: Ops pin command: `rdeploy pin --cluster canary --image redwood:v3.16 --duration 20m --reason "hotpin"` — prefer pin to full rollback if degradation is small and limited to ingress. Full rollback steps in confluence.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner: priya. Pager: +1-555-0199. Escalation: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
lucas: Copy. Please paste the short rollback checklist into this thread for visibility.
priya: TL;DR rollback checklist: 1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.15 --cluster canary` 2) `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood` 3) `redis-cli -h cache.canary FLUSHDB` 4) verify DB workers no schema errors: `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=worker | grep -i schema` 5) notify product and open incident if customer impact.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/6 OK, 2/6 OK, 3/6 degraded (p95=230ms) -> auto-pause triggered by rule p95>210ms.
lucas: Auto-pause noted. Priya, proceed with your rollback checklist unless we want a hotpin first?
priya: Given p95 spike and error-rate creeping, doing full rollback now. Executing step 1.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by priya at 2026-03-23T09:12:55Z. Will update when complete.
priya: Rollback finished on canary. Health checks back: p95=98ms, 5xx=0.05%. Recommending 15m observation.
emily: Product looped for release note edits and user-facing blurb if needed.
lucas: Thanks. Please add a short note in release ticket and schedule a 30m postmortem sync.
